title: Application ServiceDiscovery Etcd Entity
description: Etcd-specific configuration. Extends Application/ServiceDiscovery with etcd-specific settings.

name.description: Human-readable name for this etcd member.

initial_cluster_state.description: Whether this is a new cluster or joining an existing one.

initial_cluster_token.description: Token to distinguish this cluster during initialization.

advertise_client_urls.description: URLs this member advertises to clients.

listen_peer_urls.description: URLs to listen on for peer communication.

listen_client_urls.description: URLs to listen on for client communication.

snapshot_count.description: Number of committed transactions to trigger a snapshot.
